```{python}
#| echo: false
import yaml
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display, HTML

with open('projects.yml', 'r') as file:
    projects = yaml.safe_load(file)

df = pd.DataFrame(projects)

grid_html = """
<style>
  .project-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr));
    gap: 20px;
    margin: 20px 0;
  }
  article.project-card {
    border: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 20px;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  article.project-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);
  }
  article.project-card h3 {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: bold;
    margin: 0 0 6px 0;
  }
  article.project-card h3 a {
    color: #333;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.2s ease;
  }
  article.project-card h3 a:hover {
    color: #0066cc;
    text-decoration: underline;
  }
  .project-type {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #fff;
    background-color: #0066cc;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    display: inline-block;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  article.project-card p {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: #444;
    flex-grow: 1;
    margin: 0 0 12px 0;
  }
  .project-tags {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .project-tag {
    font-size: 12px;
    background-color: #f0f0f0;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    color: #555;
  }
  .project-links {
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .project-links a {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #0066cc;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  .project-links a:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
  }
</style>
<div class="project-grid">
"""

for _, project in df.iterrows():
    github = project.get('github')
    demo = project.get('demo')
    title_url = (github if pd.notna(github) else None) or (demo if pd.notna(demo) else None) or '#'
    tags_html = "".join(f'<span class="project-tag">{tag}</span>' for tag in project.get('tags', []))

    links = []
    if 'demo' in project and pd.notna(project['demo']):
        label = "Blog Post" if project.get('type') == 'Research' else "Live Demo"
        links.append(f'<a href="{project["demo"]}">{label}</a>')
    if 'notebook' in project and pd.notna(project.get('notebook')):
        links.append(f'<a href="{project["notebook"]}">Notebook</a>')
    if 'github' in project and pd.notna(project['github']):
        links.append(f'<a href="{project["github"]}">GitHub</a>')
    links_html = "\n".join(links)

    grid_html += f"""
    <article class="project-card">
        <h3><a href="{title_url}">{project['title']}</a></h3>
        <span class="project-type">{project['type']}</span>
        <p>{project['description']}</p>
        <div class="project-tags">{tags_html}</div>
        <div class="project-links">{links_html}</div>
    </article>
    """

grid_html += "</div>"
display(HTML(grid_html))
```
